newsitem.title: USA: Spartech sees growth in fiscal 1997.
newsitem.headline: Spartech sees growth in fiscal 1997.

text.p: Spartech Corp expects another year of growth in fiscal 1997, president Bradley Buechler said in remarks prepared for delivery at the company's annual meeting Wednesday.

"Based upon our current backlog and the benefits anticipated from a full year's impact of the 1996 acquisitions of Portage Industries and the Canadian-based Hamelin Group, we believe that Spartech will again enjoy an excellent year in fiscal 1997," Buechler said.

"The company's search for additional expansions, perhaps a little more global in nature, along with several new product transformations, will also likely contribute to growth in the next 12 to 36 months," Buechler added.
Spartech produces engineered thermoplastic materials, polymeric compounds and molded products.
